verdict.rationale: The only evidence of this capability is the account-merging doc, which mentions that Poke has a 'Memory' that persists with an account. That implies Poke keeps persistent memory, but nothing documents what it remembers from previous chats or how it applies that in new conversations. Missing for 10: documentation of how Memory captures context from past conversations, evidence it is applied in new chats, user controls to view or edit memory, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant remember relevant context from previous chats and apply it in new conversations

citations.quote: This keeps Poke's Memory, Recipes, and Integrations from the selected account
